draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for the note — glad it's going well so far, and no pressure at all.

When you're ready, the easiest first step is one project with a few real tasks; in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's useful, I'm happy to set up a short call this week and help you get that first project shaped around the work your team actually tracks. Either way, I'll stay out of your inbox until you need me.

Best,
Nadia
